notes:
Dahu 0.107.0 beta for Windows.

- Faster commands: the recovery copy is no longer written after every command (it cost up to a third of a second each time). It is saved in the background at the interval chosen in Preferences > Files (default every 5 minutes, down to 2 seconds after each change); quitting still saves pending changes. A simple command such as a rectangle now needs 2 internal requests instead of 6.
- Preferences: new Files tab (recovery copy frequency, a fixed unit for STL/OBJ/DXF files without units, the large-model memory check) and a tidier layout with titled sections on every tab.
- Large 3DM files: before importing, Dahu reads the file's layers and estimates the memory its display needs. When the model is too large for this computer, a "This model is large" dialog offers Reduced display quality (coarser viewport meshes only; exact geometry, measurements and exports stay exact), Choose layers, Import anyway (only while it still fits) or Cancel.
- Large files no longer crash the app: if memory runs low while loading, the import stops and is rolled back, the current document is preserved and a message explains what to try. Lighter display data in the app window.
- Loft: rotated closed sections such as ellipses are aligned like Rhino. Since 0.105.0: Rhino-like Cap=Yes/No on Loft, Sweep, Sweep2, Revolve and RailRevolve.

Unsigned: on first install choose More info > Run anyway.
